notes.title: Phantom Matrix Update 0.3.24 released
notes.content:
[h3]Game Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue that player needed to pass the prologue first level("09:00" level) every time entered the game to access the level selection scene.
(Player needs to play first stage and see cutscene at least one more time for the game to save correctly. We are really sorry for it.)
[*] Fixed the issue of not being able to enter the Prologue Boss Stage.
[/list]

notes.title: Phantom Matrix is Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248862/72f476ae500c2ecb6c2cb5ca5c135a30cbc0302c.jpg[/img]

Phantom Matrix is now available for early access on Steam, and it is on sale until 8/1. Get it early and enjoy the discount!


Current Version 0.3.0 includes:
[list]
[*] Two types of enemies
[*] Twelve stages with sixty levels
[*] Over seventy interactive objects
[*] Six puzzle mechanics
[*] The first special gadget
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248862/c58f1ce9a2d7d7a6e323e210020e687cc57a38e5.gif[/img]

We are actively working to fix all known bugs and improve the visual, audio, and haptic experience. Your feedback and suggestions are welcome on the Steam community or Discord server.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41248862/f38bde7aafd59af4bebac2a3aeef7ce90dab9e13.gif[/img]

The next major update is planned within two months, which will bring forty new levels, four additional puzzle mechanics, a new enemy type, and a new special weapon. Stay tuned!
